info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, podsFront, loopX, loopWidth, cableGuy, COPTER, firstPhoto, startMember, thisMember, frameDir, Xvel, Yvelglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChange, gScore, gGuyDoomon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  thisMember = this.memberNum  cableGuy = sprite(6)  COPTER = sprite(4)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  frameDir = 1  this.locZ = 1000  Xvel = 3  Yvel = 0  firstPhoto = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset + Xvel    Ypos = Ypos + Yvel    diffY = cableGuy.locV - this.locV    diffX = cableGuy.locH - (this.locH + 45)    if diffY > 1 then      Yvel = Yvel + 0.20000000000000001    else      Yvel = Yvel - 0.20000000000000001    end if    Yvel = Yvel * 0.90000000000000002    if (abs(diffY) < 20) and (abs(diffX) < 20) then      if gGuyDoom <> #SHARK then        puppetSound(1, member(17, "Sfx"))        gGuyDoom = #SHARK        cableGuy.sharkCounter = 150        cableGuy.rotation = this.rotation + 90        put cableGuy.rotation        this.blend = 0      end if    end if    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.ink = 0    this.rotation = Yvel * 4    thisMember = thisMember + frameDir    if thisMember > 379 then      thisMember = 379      frameDir = -frameDir    end if    if thisMember < 370 then      thisMember = 370      frameDir = -frameDir    end if    this.locH = Xpos    this.locV = Ypos    this.memberNum = thisMember    if Xpos > 600 then      Xpos = Xpos - 800      Ypos = 300    end if  end ifend
